home.welcomeHtml: I bisimila Lumesys la, i ka yɔrɔ min na i bɛ se ka san ani ka feere ka dannaya. An ka fɛn ni baarakɛwalew lajɛ, i bɛ i yɛrɛ ka sugandi.

categories.title: An ka kategoriw lajɛ
categories.description: Kategoriw lajɛ, i ka fɛn ɲini.

purchase.title: San ni nɔgɔya
purchase.description: San ka ɲɛ Lumesys kan. Feerefɛn mɔgɔ weele ka wari sara ni taga-taga kunnafonidaw dɔn.

sell.title: Feere ni dannaya
sell.description: I b’a fɛ ka fɛn dɔ bila Lumesys kan? An ka ekipi weele ka bɔli ni feere sira dɔn. I kana i ka sigili sɛbɛnw walima wari kunnafonidaw ci messagerie fɛ.
sell.whatsappMessage: Bisimila, n b’a fɛ ka fɛn dɔ bila Lumesys kan.

listings.title: I ka fɛnw ɲɛnabɔ
listings.description: Fɛnw ɲɛnabɔ yɔrɔ tɛ yen sisan Lumesys marketplace kɔnɔ. An ka ekipi bɛ se ka i dɛmɛ ka fɛn dɔ bila, yɛlɛma walima a bɔ.
listings.contact: N ka fɛn ɲɛnabɔ dɛmɛ ɲini
listings.whatsappMessage: Bisimila, n b’a fɛ ka n ka fɛn dɔ ɲɛnabɔ Lumesys kan.

help.title: Dɛmɛ mako?
help.description: An ka ekipi bɛ se ka i ka ɲininkaliw jaabi fɛnw, cidenw ani i ka jatebɔ ko la.
help.whatsappMessage: Bisimila, n mako bɛ dɛmɛ la Lumesys kan.
